text: IncorporateBegin clears a parser that fails initialization and continues writing mailbox metadata. The removed rv = NS_OK was overwritten by later writes, so removing it did not make parser failure fatal. Most writes check their results; the final keywords write still assigns rv and returns NS_OK without checking it. Preserve that exact distinction when reasoning about this cleanup; no failed write or parser run was reproduced. This is source and test-code inspection. title: POP3 parser failure and mailbox write failure have different policies
